reason: VALUE/TRANSFER lens. The cited numbers are right, but the realistic public gain is about +0.0001 and cannot be told apart from 0.003 LB noise. (1) THE NUMBERS CHECK OUT. Detector reach 121/151 (CONTEXT.md l.1142-1152). Window reach 136/151 (44b6 24/26, 6bba 112/125; l.1198). The full-frame 0.90 pass reaches 151/151 at +24% nodes (l.1259-1261). The upper bound, 15 cases at 0 FP = +0.0077 locally, is arithmetically correct. The idea is v2's 'mirror-peak-daughter' (r1_hyp_divisions.json). v2 merged it into div-cap-private-J, and no verifier ever measured the mirror arm itself. One point in the idea is wrong in its favour: readmit barely overlaps with it. x138 readmit re-uses only peaks >= 0.965 (READMIT_MIN_SCORE, cell 0), and gapfill bridges end(t)->start only, while u has a child and is not an end. The overlap is therefore ~0. (2) CEILING FROM THE FORMULA. The public anchor is a guess: TP 19 / FP 13 / FN 21, D 53. One recovered TP is worth +0.00189. One evaluable FP costs -0.00066. Break-even precision is 0.26. Reaching +0.002 needs a net of about +1.1 TP at 0 FP, or +2 TP / <= 1 FP. The public pool is the problem. The lab share of FN that no detection can reach is 15/128 = 12%, which gives ~2.5 public cases (range 2-5 if the detector is weaker on the unseen embryo). The hidden test holds 100-130 videos (CONTEXT l.14), so the public set has ~30-38. Cap 1-2 per video means 30-76 insertions. At the lab evaluable rate of 15/466 = 3%, that is ~1-2.5 evaluable insertions, and each one is a TP only if it lands on one of the ~2.5 missing-daughter divisions. I estimate a per-case recovery probability of ~0.2, the product of: h >= h_min at the daughter on an unseen embryo ~0.7, the geometry passing ~0.6, and a rank inside the cap ~0.5. Monte Carlo (scratchpad mirror_mc.py) over (cases, recovery, evaluable FP): central mean +0.0001, P(>= +0.002) 0.10, P(< 0) 0.49; optimistic (4 cases, 0.35, 1 FP) +0.0019 with P 0.39; pessimistic -0.0012. (3) GEOMETRY FAILS ON THE TARGET CASES. When a daughter is missing, the surviving node c1 is often the under-segmented merged blob between the two daughters. In v2, 17/54 claimed misses have their matched node > 4 um from the GT daughter, and 44b6 misses are mostly under-segmentation (BRIEF). With c1 near the midpoint, the mirror point 2u - c1 sits close to u, and sister(c1, x) falls to ~half the 6.4-14 um separation. The 6 um sister floor and the 5 um mirror gate then reject exactly the cases the branch exists for. Where c1 is well placed, the daughters were already ~6+ um apart and are usually both detected. (4) TRANSFER. h(x) is the in-sample detector's confidence. 151/151 at 0.90 is measured on videos the detector trained on, so the step-0 audit (peak within 3 um at h >= 0.7 vs the background rate) will overstate recall and understate the rate of junk peaks. That is the pattern that turned lab +0.01..+0.016 into LB 0 (#29/#30). DaughterNet p_par is split by 44b6 leak group, not by embryo. 44b6 contributes only 2 unreachable cases (24/26), all from one recording, so the gate 'net evaluable TP >= +3' leaves 13 in-sample 6bba cases to find 3 TP. No per-embryo check is possible, and passing that gate would be only weak evidence. (5) The node multiplier is not an issue: <= 2 nodes per video out of ~30k is ~7e-6 adj_edge. (6) PRIVATE. The break-even is lower (J 0.15-0.25, break-even 0.13-0.20) and there are ~2.4x more cases. With 1.4-3 TP and 4-5 FP at D ~130-150, the gain is +0.0005..+0.0016. It could be mildly positive, but nobody can measure it before the finals. (7) The expected public gain is < +0.002 and below 0.003 noise, so a probe gives no decision-grade signal.
fix_if_any: No version reaches +0.002 public. Least-bad repair, as a ZERO-SLOT ride-along on a probe that is going out anyway (e.g. the F1/F2 candidate after #34/#35): (a) Require two-frame evidence. Accept x only if a low peak or orphan start within 4 um exists at t+2 as well, so that x->y continues. Also drop the p_dau(c1)^a factor, which rewards exactly the merged-blob c1. (b) Handle under-segmentation explicitly. If |c1-u| < 2.5 um or the c1 half-max volume is not reduced, search for the TWO peaks symmetric about c1 (c1 +- d, d 3-7 um) instead of the mirror of c1 about u. (c) Set h_min from a non-in-sample detector: a LOEO-44b6 scratch detector (friend_a_exp02_loeo20) on the 12 LOEO videos, not the public detector on its training videos. (d) Cap at 1 per video and require p_par >= the ensemble 99th percentile (0.83). (e) Step-0 kill test on friend A's existing B35 0.90 peak cache, which needs no x138 cache: at least 8 of the 15 unreachable cases must pass (a)-(d), with the per-parent background <= 1:20. Adopt only for the PRIVATE-leaning final, and only if it is node-identical except for the <= 1/video additions. Never spend a dedicated LB slot on it.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0001 central (range -0.0013..+0.0019; P(>= +0.002) ~0.10): ~2.5 public missing-daughter divisions x ~0.2 recovery = ~0.5 TP against ~1.5 evaluable FP; +1 TP = +0.0019, +1 FP = -0.00066
